parameter_interpretation: The upstream model card accepts low/high/max only and says any other value defaults to max. The medium request was accepted by Paratera but is not an attestation that medium took effect.

output_limit_observation.interpretation: On this endpoint max_tokens is not demonstrated to cap completion usage including reasoning tokens. The calibration therefore covers input estimation only, not the complete request total or output ceiling.

complete_request_reservation_check.interpretation: The text_control request exceeded its reservation by one token. The text_long total fit only because input overestimation offset output usage above max_tokens; this is not output calibration evidence.

runtime_existing_behavior: The runtime durably records the raw response and usage before settlement. If reported total usage exceeds the per-request reservation, settlement stops with token_reservation_exceeded; the response is not accepted for the next turn, newly proposed tools are not executed, and resume preserves the fatal stop.
migration_observation: Record requested max_tokens, completion tokens, reasoning tokens, visible output and finish_reason for every GLM call, including normal answers and tool calls. Establish a separate model-specific reasoning reserve before claiming a complete-request upper bound.
conclusion: The dependency-free text input estimate is within 7.64% on these two points. The official patch grid exactly matches two square-image input increments and deliberately over-reserves the larger synthetic image because Paratera does not attest its image preprocessing. All five input upper bounds cover reported prompt usage. Output and complete-request bounds remain uncalibrated because reported completion usage can exceed requested max_tokens when reasoning is counted.
